items.headline: US pressures Europe to release diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban
items.why: A possible US diesel export ban and calls to release European reserves could tighten global diesel supply and lift prices.
implications: Global diesel prices may rise, which could raise India's fuel import costs and freight costs.
Indian refiners' export margins and trade flows for diesel may shift if US supply is cut.

items.headline: UK diesel price hits record high of £2 a litre
items.why: A proposed EU and IEA release of oil and diesel reserves, amid an Iran war pushing up prices worldwide, bears on global fuel costs that India imports.
implications: Higher global diesel and crude prices could raise India's import bill and fuel costs.
A coordinated reserve release may ease global supply pressure and temper price rises for India.

items.headline: Friday briefing: How we covered the flydubai incident as it unfolded
items.why: A violent cockpit incident on a flydubai flight raises aviation security concerns for the many Indians who fly Gulf carriers.
implications: Indian travellers on Gulf and Israel-linked routes may face tighter security checks or more caution.
Indian authorities could seek more information on crew safety and passenger welfare on such flights.

items.headline: India's 'cockroach' protesters are back - this time asking poll chief to resign
items.why: Thousands protesting in Mumbai against the poll chief puts pressure on India's election authority and domestic political climate.
implications: Pressure on the election commissioner could intensify scrutiny of how India's elections are run.
Large street protests may prompt policy or political responses and affect public order in Mumbai.
